warnings: Increase the domain height and/or move the emitter lower so the flame never reaches the domain ceiling (remove the hard rectangular cutoff).
If using adaptive domain in your setup, increase its margin so the adaptive bounds don’t clip the visible flame (or disable adaptive domain until stable).

Reduce highlight clipping: lower volume emission strength / blackbody intensity multiplier (e.g., halve flame multiplier/emission strength) and/or use Filmic + exposure adjustments rather than raw intensity.
Reduce speckling: raise Cycles samples (e.g., 256–512 for volumes), enable denoising for the render, and consider limiting max bounces for volume if noise persists.

Improve blackbody look: drive the Principled Volume temperature (or blackbody) from a simulation attribute (often a temperature/heat field) instead of a constant, so you get a real hot core → cooler edges gradient.
Add more small-scale motion/detail: increase sim resolution and/or enable noise/high-res refinement; tune vorticity/turbulence and add slight lateral wind to break symmetry.

Smooth emission: ensure your flow emission isn’t producing a hard mask (avoid non-manifold emitters; consider slightly increasing surface emission distance and lowering full-volume emission if it causes artifacts).
Check for banding from very low-density ranges: adjust density multiplier and absorption so midtones aren’t compressed into a narrow range (helps avoid stepped gradients).
